task.spec:
A 4-bit counter: reset q to zero; otherwise increment modulo 16 when en=1 and hold when en=0.
Use one SystemVerilog module with the exact interface. All state updates on rising clk. rst is synchronous, active high, and has priority. No other modules, file I/O, delays, or simulation-only behavior in the DUT.
task.constraints: SystemVerilog; xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; post-synthesis clock clk at 5 ns; simulation seed 1.
